note: A family groups occurrences that share a canonical core ask. Families key on (question_id, limb_label) because most families below recur at LIMB level, not question level. Two counts are kept strictly apart: frequency_known counts VERIFIED SITTINGS and nothing else, and must always equal known_occurrences.length; official_bank_ancestor names an item of the Directorate General of Shipping's own published question bank, which fixes an official wording but carries NO date and is therefore never counted as a sitting.
phase2_schema_change: v1 carried a single 'confidence' field per family. It conflated three independent things and has been replaced by text_similarity_confidence, date_confidence and source_confidence. A family may now correctly read HIGH / NONE / HIGH - the recurrence is certain, the historical date is unproven, the source is excellent.
phase2_headline: The Directorate General of Shipping publishes its own 'Question Bank MEO CL-I' (185 items). Four of the six families below have an OFFICIAL ancestor in it, and across the 40-paper solved corpus 63 questions match a bank item strongly. This replaced third-party scans as the evidence base for recurrence, and it overturned two Phase-1 findings that had understated how much of QP2608 has an ancestor. It does not date anything.

dormancy_classes.ACTIVE_RECURRENCE: appeared in 2 or more sittings within the last 24 months
dormancy_classes.RECENT_RETURN: previous appearance 24-48 months before the current sitting
dormancy_classes.HISTORICAL_RETURN: previous PROVEN appearance more than 48 months before, with both ends of the gap evidenced
dormancy_classes.LONG_GAP_RETURN: reserved. Requires proven occurrences at BOTH ends of the gap. A gap in MIW's holdings is not proof the examiner stopped asking.
dormancy_classes.ONE_OFF_HISTORICAL: exactly one known prior appearance and no pattern
dormancy_classes.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: the corpus cannot support a dormancy claim

threshold_justification: The 24/48-month cuts follow the sitting calendar, not statistics: MEO Class I sits about eleven times a year, so 24 months is roughly 22 sittings - long enough that a candidate preparing from recent papers would still have met the question - and 48 months is roughly a full preparation generation. These are proposed, not settled. The far more important rule is the last class: MIW's sitting evidence floor is January 2021, so any 'dormant since 2012' claim is really 'not seen in the window MIW can see'.
phase2_dormancy_correction: Phase 1 classed FAMILY-EM-0001 and FAMILY-EM-0002 as LONG_DORMANT_REVIVAL on a 14-year gap. Both rested on a single third-party source whose full text was never preserved in the repository, so neither end of the gap is now evidenced as a sitting. Both are reclassified INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, and LONG_GAP_RETURN is reserved until a family has proven sittings at both ends. The recurrence itself did not weaken - it strengthened, because an official ancestor was found for each. Only the DATE claim fell.

families.canonical_core_ask: State the preparations and trials required to bring a ship out of a major lay-up and offer it to the surveying authorities.
families.similarity_basis: against BANK-015, containment 1.00 forward and 1.00 reverse
families.limb_note: Recurs at limb (a) only, 10 of the 16 marks. Limb (b), on how a laid-up notation affects intermediate, annual and special surveys, has no ancestor in the official bank and none anywhere else located. It is the remaining 6 marks.

unverified_asserted_occurrences.why_not_counted: The source's full content was never preserved in the repository; only a 3,043-byte stub exists and the recorded sha256 hashes that stub, not the historical text. The reading cannot be reproduced from anything MIW holds. See SRC-SCRIBD-106245627 in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.

families.phase2_note: Phase 1 rested this family on the unpreserved third-party source and classed it a 14-year revival. The official bank supersedes that source for the WORDING - and does so at a strictly higher provenance tier - but supplies no date. The correct reading is: the recurrence is certain and officially evidenced; there is no proven earlier sitting at all. Do not tell a candidate this was 'not asked for 14 years'.
families.related_miw_family: MIW's own six-year layer holds a lay-up family (QP2101-Q4, QP2107-Q1, QP2109-Q1, QP2110-Q5, QP2111-Q5, QP2206-Q5) setting the INVERSE question - preservation of machinery going INTO lay-up. Negative control NC-6 confirms the classifier separates them (NO_MEANINGFUL_MATCH). Not counted here.

families.canonical_core_ask: State the coordination and exchange of information with the Master for entering dry dock, the preparations and delegation to the engineers, and the inspections and co-operation with the dock authorities for undocking.
families.similarity_basis: against BANK-018, containment 1.00 forward and 1.00 reverse
families.limb_note: PHASE 2 CORRECTION, and the largest single change to the Paper DNA. Phase 1 held that only the Master-coordination sentence had an ancestor and that 'roughly two thirds of the 16 marks have no ancestor'. BANK-018 carries all three limbs and matches the whole question at 1.00/1.00. All 16 marks have an official ancestor. The question prints no subpart labels, so it is compared whole; Phase 1's 'limb-1' was an analytical segment MIW invented, not a printed limb.

unverified_asserted_occurrences.why_not_counted: As FAMILY-EM-0001. The stub-only preservation also explains the Phase-1 error: the third-party excerpt carried the first sentence alone, so the remaining two limbs looked ancestorless when they were not.

families.related_miw_family: QP2109-Q3 and QP2110-Q9 both set 'explain how you will prepare vessel for dry docking', covering the preparation limb, and show the topic live in 2021. BANK-164 sets dry-docking project planning. Negative control NC-4 confirms the classifier separates BANK-018 from BANK-164 (NO_MEANINGFUL_MATCH). Neither is counted as an occurrence of this family.

families.canonical_core_ask: As Chief Engineer, address lack of motivation, differences in attitude, and the sense of competitiveness, for better management and effective control.
families.similarity_basis: against BANK-054, containment 1.00 forward and 1.00 reverse; against OCC-2025-12-Q4B, 0.94/0.94 under the declared normalisation
families.limb_note: The strongest and cleanest recurrence in the paper. It is nevertheless a LIMB: every MIW occurrence pairs the sentence with 'Explain Abraham Maslow's theory of motivation' and carries 16 marks between the two. In August 2026 the Maslow limb is absent and the limb carries 6 marks. A candidate told 'Q8 is a repeat' would over-prepare Maslow and under-prepare limb (a), which is 10 marks and is a DIFFERENT family.
families.phase2_note: The official bank settles the shape of this family. BANK-054 is the motivation sentence ALONE, with no Maslow limb and with the same 'on board' spacing August 2026 uses. So the bank item is the primitive; MIW's 2021, 2022 and 2025 occurrences are the EXTENDED form; August 2026 returns to the primitive. This is recurrence structure change, not legal change.
families.date_note: Earliest KNOWN sitting is March 2021 only because that is MIW's evidence floor. The Founder hypothesis places it at March 2010; it could not be tested and remains unsupported. See verification/H5. The bank's existence supplies a better explanation for the long-run recurrence than any particular 2010 sitting.
families.answer_donor: QP2512-Q4 is solved and carries a verified MIW answer for this segment.

families.canonical_core_ask: Explain warranties under the Marine Insurance Act.
families.similarity_basis: The limb stem is the single word 'Warranties' and is UNSCOREABLE_SHORT_STEM on its own; it inherits from parent question QP2608-Q4, which matches BANK-072 at 0.93 forward / 1.00 reverse.
families.phase2_repair: THIS FAMILY CARRIED THE PHASE-1 DEFECT. It declared frequency_known 5, earliest_occurrence 2021-02 and previous_before_current 2026-06 while known_occurrences held exactly one id. The four ancestors named in its own dormancy_caveat - QP2102-Q8, QP2202-Q8, QP2312-Q3(b), QP2606-Q3(b) - were each independently re-verified against MIW's holdings and have now been serialised as occurrence records. The declared counts were CORRECT and the records were missing, so the repair created the four records rather than reducing frequency to 1. All five fields are now derived from the same list and the validator enforces it.
families.limb_note: Only limb (b) of four recurs at limb level - 4 of the 16 marks - but see the whole-question note below. The command also weakens across the family: earlier occurrences say 'differentiate ... with an example' (8 marks), August 2026 says 'write short notes' (4 marks). Under the declared normalisation a changed command verb is NOT normalised away, which is why this is SAME_CORE_ASK and not EXACT_REPEAT.
families.whole_question_note: PHASE 2 CORRECTION. Phase 1 recorded limbs (a) Deviation, (c) War Risk Clause and (d) Charterers Contribution Clause as having 'NO ancestor in MIW's holdings', and called (d) 'the least-supported limb in the whole paper'. Official bank item BANK-072 is QP2608-Q4 in full, all four limbs, essentially verbatim. All 16 marks have an official ancestor. The whole-question relationship is tracked as FAMILY-EM-0007.

families.canonical_core_ask: Underline the general procedures for flow of information among ships personnel; on a multinational-crew ship state how effective communication can be approached and how a shore-office instruction can best be utilised.
families.similarity_basis: against BANK-105, containment 0.48 forward and 0.96 reverse - the bank item is absorbed whole and extended
families.phase2_note: NEW IN PHASE 2, and only visible because similarity is now measured in BOTH directions. Phase 1 recorded Q8(a) as having no ancestor. Forward containment is a weak 0.48, which is why a one-directional test missed it; reverse containment is 0.96, because BANK-105 sits inside the modern question almost entirely. August 2026 then adds a PSC-failure scenario, an 'initial meeting' setting and a demand for examples. Added scenario conditions are NOT normalised away, so this is SAME_CORE_ASK and must never be presented as a verbatim repeat.
families.product_warning: Q8(a) is 10 marks and Q8(b) is 6. They belong to DIFFERENT families with different strength. Any candidate-facing statement about 'Q8' must be limb-level or it will mislead.

families.canonical_core_ask: What are the ongoing developments at IMO on the technical and operational measures to be invoked on board ships for combating greenhouse gas emissions?
families.dormancy_gap: 5 months between the two known sittings
families.similarity_basis: OCC-2024-02-Q5 against BANK-135, containment 0.93 forward and 0.87 reverse; OCC-2023-09-Q3 extends it with market-based measures
families.not_in_qp2608: This family does not appear in QP2608. It is carried because it is the only family in MIW's holdings whose stem asks explicitly for a CURRENT STATE OF PLAY, which makes it the sharpest available test of temporal answer intelligence. It is Temporal Delta pilot C.
families.phase2_note: The stem is a standing invitation to state the current position. That makes the answer, uniquely in this corpus, guaranteed to go stale - and it gives the only genuinely demonstrable DO NOT WRITE TODAY item found in Phase 2.

families.canonical_core_ask: As per the Marine Insurance Act, write short notes on Deviation, Warranties, War Risk Clause and Charterers Contribution Clause.
families.similarity_basis: against BANK-072, containment 0.93 forward and 1.00 reverse
families.relationship_to_family_em_0004: FAMILY-EM-0004 tracks the WARRANTIES limb across sittings; this family tracks the WHOLE four-limb question against its official ancestor. They are deliberately separate: the limb has five proven sittings and no bank-level date, the whole question has one proven sitting and an official ancestor. Collapsing them would let the limb's five sittings appear to evidence the whole question, which they do not.

excluded_from_families: QP2608-Q1(b) - laid-up notation and its effect on survey cycles. No ancestor in the 185-item official bank and none located elsewhere. 6 marks.

QP2608-Q3 - Hague/Hague-Visby objectives and cargo abandonment. Best official-bank match is BANK-041 (responsibilities and liabilities under Hague-Visby) at 0.38/0.20, which is a different ask. Negative control NC-2 holds: the cargo-abandonment limb does not false-positive against ship abandonment or wreck.
QP2608-Q5 - main propulsion failure with power intact, calm and heavy weather. Best bank match 0.50. New.
QP2608-Q6 - scrubbers and zero-discharge port zones. Best bank match 0.25. New.
QP2608-Q7 - dead main switchboard entry, permit to work, power restoration. Best bank match 0.36. New.
QP2608-Q9 - CII 'D' rating for two consecutive years, corrective action plan under MARPOL Annex VI reg. 28.8. Best bank match BANK-135 at 0.19, which is topical only. New.
A topic relationship is not a family. These are recorded in each question's recurrence_adjudication in the spec.
